# Rishiraj Sajeev - Full Stack Developer Portfolio

> A modern, performant portfolio website built with Angular 20 and Tailwind CSS v4, showcasing the work of Rishiraj Sajeev.

This portfolio highlights my skills and experience as a full-stack developer specializing in Angular, Vue 3, React, and NestJS.
